**Exploring food and business themes**

I'm thinking about "Yellow Pages," which might connect to business and money. I wonder if it relates to food, maybe in a restaurant menu context? The idea of a yellow paper menu and cost, along with brown food packaging, is interesting. Then there's also the concept of a "brown paper bag lunch." Maybe I should also consider the "golden ticket" idea, possibly with chocolate incorporated. It’s a fun blend of themes to explore!
